紅樓夢・主要女性角色

角色設定集· 8 位角色 · 1 張設定圖 · 依戲份排序
故事摘要

故事置於清代貴族宅院與大觀園的日常生活之中，少女、少奶奶與貼身丫鬟在禮法、家族責任與真實性情之間各自尋找容身之處。林黛玉、薛寶釵與史湘雲因親族關係寄居賈府，王熙鳳主持家務，賈探春在家族秩序中展現治理才具，妙玉則以帶髮修行者身分住進園中。晴雯與襲人同為賈寶玉身邊的重要侍女，卻以截然不同的方式面對身分限制。八人的交往、詩社、家務與情感牽引，共同構成一幅繁華而暗含裂痕的女性群像。

林黛玉

主角 又稱　黛玉 · 林妹妹 · 顰兒 · 瀟湘妃子 寄居賈府的敏銳才女，以詩、眼淚與近乎苛刻的真誠守住自己的感情和尊嚴。

左：半身像　右：全身三視圖

外貌

身形纖細，帶著先天不足的病弱感；眉形若輕煙微蹙，雙眼含情而常有淚光，呼吸細弱，靜時清雅、動時輕盈。（推斷）面色偏白，黑髮柔細，服飾取蘇州文雅氣質，以月白、煙粉與竹青等低飽和色為主，避免繁重珠翠壓過人物。

性情

初入賈府時處處留心，害怕言行失當；熟悉之後則言詞機敏，能迅速看破人情中的敷衍與親疏。她的尖銳往往是自我保護，情感核心仍是對真心與平等的強烈要求。

動機

在寄人籬下的環境中保存人格與情感自主，並確認自己所珍惜的關係不是被禮法或利益替代。

角色弧線

從謹慎寄居、以詩文建立自我，到愈發清楚家族秩序無法容納她所要求的純粹；她以不妥協的情感姿態持續對抗被安排的人生。

生圖提示詞

半寫實人物插畫：出身蘇州、寄居十八世紀清代京城貴族宅院的十五歲漢族少女。身形纖細，窄鵝蛋臉，煙眉微蹙，深色杏眼含著濕潤淚光，鼻樑纖直，唇色淡，肩膀柔弱而姿態內斂。中分黑髮梳成克制的古典髮髻，以小型白玉簪固定，兩側留柔細鬢髮。穿月白與煙粉色層疊絲衣，竹青滾邊，暗織花紋，窄袖、柔軟褶裙，手持素色絲帕。皮膚保留毛孔與自然膚色變化，眼睛有濕潤高光，眉眼略不對稱，髮際線有碎髮；絲料有織紋、重量與褶皺自陰影。四分之三半身視角，中性背景，左上柔和方向主光與冷調補光，淺景深，面部最清晰。

生圖提示詞 EN

Semi-realistic character illustration of a slender fifteen-year-old Han Chinese aristocratic girl from Suzhou living in an elite mid-Qing-dynasty household in 18th-century Beijing. Delicate narrow oval face, softly arched smoke-like brows with a slight worried pinch, large dark almond eyes with a moist reflective gaze, fine straight nose, small pale lips, translucent fair complexion, fragile shoulders and a quiet inward posture. Centre-parted glossy black hair in a restrained period updo with a small white-jade hairpin and two soft side locks. She wears layered pale moon-white and muted dusty-pink silk robes with bamboo-green piping, subtle woven blossom motifs, narrow sleeves, a soft pleated skirt and a plain silk handkerchief. Skin with visible pores and uneven tone, faint capillaries at the nostrils and ear rims, subtle subsurface scattering; eyes with a wet specular highlight, moist lower lid, visible iris fibres and a limbal ring; eyelids and eyebrows slightly asymmetric; individual flyaway hairs break the silhouette. Fabric has visible weave, real weight and self-shadowing folds. Three-quarter waist-up view, plain neutral background, soft directional key light from the upper left with cool fill, shallow depth of field, face in sharpest focus. Semi-realistic painterly rendering with soft blended edges and visible brush texture, anatomically grounded.

角色設定圖提示詞 EN

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: production character model sheet. Create a single character model sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas for a slender fifteen-year-old Han Chinese aristocratic girl from Suzhou living in an elite mid-Qing-dynasty household in 18th-century Beijing. Delicate narrow oval face, softly arched smoke-like brows with a slight worried pinch, large dark almond eyes with a moist reflective gaze, fine straight nose, small pale lips, translucent fair complexion, fragile shoulders and a quiet inward posture. Centre-parted glossy black hair in a restrained period updo with a small white-jade hairpin and two soft side locks. Layered pale moon-white and muted dusty-pink silk robes with bamboo-green piping, subtle woven blossom motifs, narrow sleeves, a soft pleated skirt, embroidered cloth shoes and a plain silk handkerchief. The canvas is divided into three zones by thin hairline rules. LEFT ZONE occupies about 34% of the canvas width: one large front-facing bust portrait, head and shoulders, centred like an ID photograph. BOTH SHOULDERS ARE FULLY VISIBLE with clear space on either side; no side cropping, fade, vignette or rounded bottom; end the portrait with a clean straight horizontal cut below the chest. This portrait is the facial identity anchor. Skin has visible pores and uneven tone, faint capillaries and subtle subsurface scattering; eyes have wet highlights, moist lower lids and visible iris fibres; eyelids and brows are slightly asymmetric; flyaway hairs break the silhouette. LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key light from the upper left with gentle falloff and ambient occlusion under the chin, in the eye sockets and at the collar. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views of the SAME character, front, left profile and back, standing side by side on one shared ground line. Their faces must match the bust portrait exactly: same features, hairstyle and calm melancholy expression. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: equal height and head-to-body ratio, correct limb lengths, natural anatomy, feet on the ground line, clear margin above and below, no stretching, squashing or foreshortening. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting with no directional key and no cast shadows. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four small isolated detail studies, evenly spaced and smaller than the figures: the white-jade hairpin, the moist eye and smoke-like brow, bamboo-green silk piping and woven blossom motif, the folded silk handkerchief, and embroidered cloth shoe. If details do not fit, continue them down the right edge; the detail studies give way, not the figures. Plain pure white background throughout, generous even margins, no scenery, no written labels, no text, no watermark. Semi-realistic character illustration, painterly rendering with soft blended edges and visible brush texture, anatomically grounded. Fabric has visible weave, wear and shine, real cloth weight and self-shadowing folds.

負向提示詞

plastic or waxy skin, over-smoothed airbrushed complexion, poreless doll face, perfectly symmetrical face, dead flat eyes without specular highlight, helmet-like hair with no loose strands, flat untextured fabric with no weave or wear, stiff mannequin posing, gaudy imperial crown, modern clothing, extra fingers, malformed hands, text, labels, watermark, signature, busy or patterned background, harsh cast shadows on the backdrop

配音提示詞

約十五歲的少女聲線。清澈纖細的輕女高音，帶淡淡氣聲與貼近耳邊的濕潤共鳴。音高落在中高區，音量克制，咬字精準，官話中帶輕柔江南語感。平時緩慢安靜，譏誚或自我防衛時語速突然加快；情緒變化細微，脆弱被壓在字後，帶乾燥機敏的幽默感。

配音提示詞 EN

A teenage female voice around fifteen. Clear, delicate light soprano with a faint breathy edge and a moist intimate resonance. Mid-high pitch, controlled volume, precise diction, and a slightly soft Jiangnan colouring within educated Mandarin. Usually measured and quiet, but quickens sharply when teasing or defending herself. Fine emotional micro-variation, restrained vulnerability, dry wit, and tears held just behind the words.

角色設定圖提示詞 EN

Create a character model sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas for a striking seventeen-year-old Han Chinese senior maid in an elite mid-Qing-dynasty household in 18th-century Beijing. Slender flexible waist, narrow shoulders, sharp oval face, expressive lifted eyes, fine brows, defiant mouth, black hair in a practical high knot with red cord and loose strands. Fitted pomegranate-red cotton-silk jacket with moon-white collar, indigo pleated skirt, simple sash, needle case and folded gold-thread fabric. Thin hairline rules divide three zones. LEFT ZONE about 34%: large front-facing bust identity anchor, both shoulders visible, margins clear, straight lower cut. LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft upper-left key with volume and ambient occlusion. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: front, left profile and back FULL-BODY views of the SAME character on one ground line; faces match the bust exactly. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: equal height, consistent body ratio, correct anatomy, no stretching, squashing or foreshortening. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic light, no cast shadows. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: small details of the red hair cord, defiant eye and brow, needle case, gold-thread repair seam, and practical cloth shoe. Details may continue down the right edge; the detail studies give way, not the figures. Pure white background, generous margins, no labels or text. Semi-realistic character illustration, painterly rendering with soft blended edges and visible brush texture, anatomically grounded. Natural skin, flyaway hair, visible weave and worn cuffs.
